description: Seriously slow LFO: one cycle lasts from a minute to a hundred months, with a sine, a triangle, a sawtooth and a square running from it.

params.text: Makes the duration number count in that unit, minutes, hours, days, weeks or months, and restarts the cycle; the lit one is the unit in use.
Sets how many of the chosen time units make one cycle, 1 to 100.
Sets how much of the voltage at the DURATION input is added to that number of units, from full inverted to full; 10V at full adds 10.
Shifts the start of the cycle, 0 to 360 degrees.
Sets how much of the voltage at the PHASE input shifts the cycle, from full inverted to full; 10V at full is a whole cycle.
Rounds the phase setting to the nearest quarter cycle, so 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees; the light is lit while that rounding is on.
Chooses the range of every output: -5V to 5V, or 0-10V.
Restarts the cycle at the phase setting.

inputs.text: Voltage added to the number of time units through its attenuverter.
Voltage shifting the start of the cycle through its attenuverter.
A trigger here restarts the cycle at the phase setting.

outputs.text: The sine wave at the set duration.
The triangle wave at the set duration.
The sawtooth wave at the set duration.
The square wave at the set duration, half of every cycle high and half low.

inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
